name: UQ Master of Business Analytics Financial Hardship Scholarship
summary: Living-cost scholarship for UQ Graduate Certificate or Master of Business Analytics students facing financial hardship.
who: Enrolled or intending to enrol in the Graduate Certificate in Business Analytics or Master of Business Analytics in the semester of the award.
Can provide documentary evidence of financial hardship.
how: Apply using the online form with evidence such as a current health care card or recent ATO statement, and a personal statement of up to 500 words.
